description: Shared Renovate preset for timblankers repos. Extend it with "extends": ["github>timblankers/.github"]. See README.md.

packageRules.description: Pin the Dockerfile base image (ARG NODE_IMAGE) by digest (app-template decision 008).

One Node.js PR updates .nvmrc, the Dockerfile NODE_IMAGE and devEngines.runtime together. Node versioning only offers LTS releases, so no odd/Current majors (decision 002). Declared after group:allNonMajor so Node stays out of that group.
prBodyNotes: Set `devEngines.packageManager.version` in package.json to the npm bundled with this Node (the `npm` field for this version in https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json), or `npm ci` fails with EBADDEVENGINES (decision 002).

packageRules.description: The node:<version>-trixie-slim image often appears a day or two after the Node release; wait longer for .nvmrc and devEngines so the Dockerfile lands in the same PR.
npm is the version bundled with Node (decision 002), not the latest standalone npm. It is bumped by hand in the Node.js PR.
@types/node follows the Node major; bump its major by hand together with a Node major.
TypeScript stays on 6.0.x until typescript-eslint supports 7 (app-template decision 004).
Apps call this repo's reusable workflow at @main on purpose (README.md); don't pin it to a SHA.
